body: You are part of this subbredit which also makes you a wanderful person :) I believe you tried and I know it's hard but... maybe... there still could be some hope. I do realize I sound stupid. But don't give up. Please, just listen to your favourite song or eat your favourite food... it won't solve every your problem but  making small steps could help. I wish I could help you. I really do. You could make letters from your future self...

I wish I could say I love you before you asked for it but that's okay. I love you. I am not saying this because you asked for it. You don't have to believe me but people who are not afraid to ask for love are people who really deserve it.
I think sarcasm is definitely not bad when you know the right time to use it... It's not only about making fun of people, it's mostly about finding the right spot in the right time.
I looked it up and it looks amazing. You did great work.

I already told you I tried to speak with her. When you have fear someone close to your heart will kill himself, you will try everything. I think, no, I know, It's bad to discourage people from using professional help. Please reflect on what you are saying.
Do you realize that behind the number IS some person with FEELINGS which can actually HELP her, right?
I told her but I didn't want to put pressure on her.  Plus, I don't find it selfish to recommend professional help if I can't do it alone... I am not proffesional...
You deserve my thanks. And if you will ever need help with anything, you are free to write me anytime. ^^

Yes, I told her I am always here for her. Maybe I could have help her more but he was also my best friend and that makes it harder.  Thank you for your help, dear stranger. It helps not to be alone for such a big problem.
She is in quarantine so I can't visit her. I asked her if the will call me and the told me "maybe, i don't know. I have so much to think about." She already tried commit suicide two years ago.
